name: Lake George Family Campground
note: Family campground of about 74 wooded sites at 1935 S Jackson Ave, south of Harrison in Clare County (not the New York park of the same name). Operator rate: $50/night with your own camper, $55 on holiday nights. Not on RV Life; Google 4.6 over 128 reviews. --Claude
